rav-chana-bar-bizna.name: Rav Ḥana bar Bizna
rav-chana-bar-bizna.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits teachings of Rabbi Shimon Ḥasida.
rav-chana-bar-bizna.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a full dark beard flecked with grey and an olive-brown wool mantle, gesturing gently as he passes on his teacher’s words; background of a mud-brick study hall with an oil lamp.

rabbi-shimon-chasida.name: Rabbi Shimon Ḥasida
rabbi-shimon-chasida.bio: Sage called Ḥasida, “the pious,” whose teachings Rav Ḥana bar Bizna transmits.
rabbi-shimon-chasida.prompt: A gentle sage in his 60s with a long grey beard and a plain undyed linen mantle, with a humble, kindly expression, hands folded; background of limestone arches and olive trees.

rav-ika-brei-derav-ami.name: Rav Ika, son of Rav Ami
rav-ika-brei-derav-ami.bio: Amora cited as Rav Ika, son of Rav Ami.
rav-ika-brei-derav-ami.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short brown beard and a plum-coloured wool mantle, raising a finger as he links two rulings to their source; background of a mud-brick study hall lit by an oil lamp.
